concept: Keep the established GovCare clinical cards and brand. Separate recorded values, severity, dated trend, input coverage, evidence quality and future prediction. Prominent severe low-potassium verification finding. Neutral coverage tracks; concise expandable provenance and rule explanations. Do not invent probabilities, data or treatment orders. Improve this existing product interface into a production-ready version of itself, keeping its layout and section order: nothing moves to a new place, though spacing and alignment may be tightened. Work inside its existing visual language: its palette, typography voice, and image treatment stay, and everything around them is sharpened - spacing rhythm, alignment, surfaces, control affordances, ink, and type rendering. Keep the product's logo, wordmark, and brand imagery as they are. Keep only the same product: its name and wordmark, and what it is. The brief decides how much of the page's other text and control copy survives; invent no product facts, features, prices, or data. These are conservation defaults, not a freeze: the brief above outranks them, and they outrank the page as it stands.
